disposition.note: The whole outer table, one connected component. Fills and column edges now agree with the reference within a device pixel; the component is the table drawn 12.9pt higher with shorter rows. The serif 10pt face and size stand in for the styles part's Carlito 11pt (#2243), and the leading empty paragraph's 8pt after and 12.95pt line are lost (#2394), so every row is shorter. The outer left and right rules are black stubs where the reference paints continuous AEAAAA rules (#2395 colour, #2145 missing middle segments). The empty paragraph closing the outer cell adds a line under the nested table (#2238). The nested West, Central and East cells are centred instead of top-aligned (#2401).

Nested-table cell text (West, Approve/d, Centra/l, Pending, East): each row is shorter and higher for the face and size (#2243) and the lost spacing (#2394), so GT and output glyphs sit at different heights; the single-line cells are also centred instead of top-aligned (#2401).
